title: MetricGroup
description: A named collection of Metrics, such as `Profitability` or `Supply Chain`. A Metric Group organizes related metrics for browsing and governance; it holds metrics without owning them, so deleting a group leaves its metrics intact and merely ungrouped.

id.description: Unique identifier that identifies this Metric Group instance.

name.description: Name that identifies this Metric Group uniquely.

fullyQualifiedName.description: A unique name that identifies a Metric Group. Metric Groups do not nest, so this is the bare name.

displayName.description: Display Name that identifies this Metric Group.

description.description: Description of the Metric Group, summarising what the metrics inside it have in common.

metrics.description: Metrics that belong to this group. This relationship-derived field is used internally for mutations and is exposed to clients only through the authorized, paginated `/v1/metricGroups/{id}/metrics` endpoint.

metricCount.description: Count of non-deleted metrics in this group. Computed on read and never stored.

updatedAt.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the entity in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

impersonatedBy.description: Bot user that performed the action on behalf of the actual user.

href.description: Link to the resource corresponding to this entity.

changeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

incrementalChangeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

deleted.description: When `true` indicates the entity has been soft deleted.

domains.description: Domains the Metric Group belongs to.

dataProducts.description: List of data products this entity is part of.

extension.description: Entity extension data with custom attributes added to the entity.
